description_en: Queries the details of asynchronous import and export tasks
description_zh: 查看异步导入导出任务的详情
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-load-tasks-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-bp2590j0000 --start-time 2021-05-18T06:00:00Z --end-time 2021-05-18T06:30:00Z --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLoadTasksRecords

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the region IDs supported by a specified Data Warehouse Edition
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看指定数仓版支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the details of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in a specified region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). Set the query start time to a point in time within the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 建议查询开始时间设置为30天内的任意时间点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需晚于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database involved in the import or export task
parameters.help_zh: 导入导出任务所涉及的数据库名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of records per page. Valid values:
30 (default).
50.
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：
30（默认值）。
50。
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为：大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Sorts tasks in ascending or descending order based on a specified field. The value must be a JSON string. Example: `[{"Field":"CreateTime", "Type":"desc"}]`

`Field` specifies the field by which to sort. Valid fields: `State`, `CreateTime`, `DBName`, `ProcessID`, `UpdateTime`, `JobName`, and `ProcessRows`.
`Type` specifies the sort order. Valid values: `Desc` (descending) and `Asc` (ascending). The values are case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh:
按指定字段对任务进行升序或降序排列。参数值需为JSON字符串类型，例如：`[{"Field":"CreateTime", "Type":"desc"}]`

`Field`表示需要排序的字段名，支持的字段为：`State`、`CreateTime`、`DBName`、`ProcessID`、`UpdateTime`、`JobName`和`ProcessRows`。
`Type`表示排序类型，取值范围为`Desc`（降序）或`Asc`（升序），取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The status of the asynchronous import or export task to query. Valid values:
INIT: The task is being initialized.
RUNNING: The task is running.
FINISH: The task is successful.
FAILED: The task failed
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的异步导入或导出任务的状态，取值范围如下：
INIT：任务初始化。
RUNNING：任务进行中。
FINISH：任务执行成功。
FAILED：任务执行失败
parameters.name: state

CreateTime.description_en: The start time of the task, accurate to milliseconds. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，精确到毫秒，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

DBName.description_en: The name of the database involved in the import or export task
DBName.description_zh: 导入导出任务涉及的数据库名称

ProcessRows.description_en: The number of data rows processed by the asynchronous import or export task
ProcessRows.description_zh: 异步导入导出任务所处理的数据行数

Sql.description_en: The SQL statement used in the asynchronous import or export task
Sql.description_zh: 异步导入导出任务中使用的SQL语句详情
Sql.example: insert overwrite into courses_external_table\nselect * from courses

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the task status was updated, accurate to milliseconds. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 任务状态的更新时间，精确到毫秒，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

PageSize.description_en: The number of records on the current page
